card.name: The word times after a number
card.fires_on: The word "times" right after a count such as two, three, four or five, when it states how often something happens. It is most common in dosing and exercise frequency like "three times a day" or "three times per week".

modes.label: Dose frequency
modes.description: "times" after a number in dosing instructions, followed by a day or week period.
modes.example: Divide the total daily dose in 3 doses and administer 3<< times>> daily.

modes.label: Exercise or daily routine frequency
modes.description: "times" after a number in general text about how often an activity is done.
modes.example: Get involved in regular cardio exercise for 30 minutes five<< times>> a week such as walking, swimming,

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words for a repeating period such as annually, yearly and weekly, and away from scope and range.
card.plain: It notices the word "times" in phrases like "three times a day" and expects a time period to follow.
